item.text: South Australia’s Independent Commissioner Against Corruption evaluated the Public Trustee’s systems to identify ways to prevent corruption, misconduct and maladministration.
item.support:
The recommendations in this report are intended to provide practical ways to advance comprehensive and 
effective systems

item.text: The evaluation focused on administering trusts and deceased and personal estates, together with preparing wills.
item.support:
The focus of this report is on Public Trustee’s practices, policies and procedures in relation to Public 
Trustee’s core business

item.text: The Commissioner concluded that integrity risks would remain high without the recommended changes and that adequate resources were needed to reduce them.
item.support:
Accordingly 
Public Trustee will need adequate resourcing in order to effectively reduce that risk.

item.text: The Commissioner made 19 recommendations addressing organisational arrangements, electronic systems, information security, training, customer service and estate assets.
item.support: I have made 19 recommendations in this report

item.quote:
Many of the recommendations in this report would have the same effect but without the implementation of 
those recommendations, the risk of corruption, misconduct and maladministration will remain high.
